summary: Frontend E2E testing of new Maintenance 'Providers' tab and public/managed Contact page. All 11 critical scenarios PASSED: public /contact loads with 'Get in touch' + info@haulcheck.co.uk card, blank-form validation blocks submit with error toast ('Please add your name, email and a message'), valid submit shows contact-success + 'Message sent' toast, login page 'Contact us' link points to /contact, sidebar nav-contact exists after manager login and navigates to /contact, Providers tab reachable via /maintenance?tab=providers, provider create with signed-contract file upload succeeds (row shows '1 file(s)'), edit updates the name, delete removes the row, manager inbox lists prior messages and contact-delete-message removes a row.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.js triggers a fetch to /api/contact-messages when /contact loads without a token, producing two 401s in the console. Harmless but noisy — gate the inbox fetch on presence of a token to keep the public page's console clean.
Dashboard shows Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings — a chart container is temporarily collapsed on mount. Cosmetic, but worth adding minWidth/minHeight or aspect.
seed_data_creation: Submitted one public test contact message (deleted during inbox test). Created, edited, and deleted a 'TEST_Acme Truck Services' provider — no residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Providers CRUD + FileUpload flows work end-to-end via /api/upload. The public Contact page produces harmless 401s from an inbox fetch when unauthenticated. Sidebar 'nav-contact' testid is generated from the item.id in Layout.js (line 84). Provider-type Select opens with 9 options.
